one_liner: LinkedIn Ads (Marketing/Advertising API) is a broad REST API with 3-legged OAuth2; self-serve app creation but Advertising API product requires LinkedIn approval, with Development tier limited to 5 editable ad accounts.
auth_notes: 3-legged authorization code flow with rw_ads/r_ads scopes; refresh tokens supported; developer portal token generator available for testing.
access_notes: Apps are created self-serve in the Developer Portal, but the Advertising API product must be applied for and approved. Development tier allows edits on up to 5 ad accounts; Standard tier requires a separate upgrade application. The API is free of charge.
blocker_notes: The Advertising API product requires LinkedIn approval, and the Standard tier requires a further upgrade for production use with many accounts. Development tier approval is typically available to approved developers with an active Campaign Manager account.

evidence.quote: OAuth 2.0 three-legged (authorization code) flow — the flow every Marketing API call uses.
All applications start with Development tier. You must apply separately to upgrade to the Standard tier.
edit capabilities for up to five (5) Ad Accounts.
The APIs are currently provided for free, but LinkedIn reserves the right to charge for the APIs in the future.
These APIs provide all features available in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, including creation and management of ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, ad types, and analytics.
There's no official LinkedIn MCP. This fills the gap with a thin, correctness-first wrapper
